title: Entamoeba histolytica: In Silico and In Vitro Oligomerization of EhHSTF5 Enhances Its Binding to the HSE of the EhPgp5 Gene Promoter.
authors: Perez-Mora, Salvador; Perez-Ishiwara, David Guillermo; Salgado-Hernandez, Sandra Viridiana; Medel-Flores, Maria Olivia; Reyes-Lopez, Cesar Augusto; Rodriguez, Mario Alberto; Sanchez-Monroy, Virginia; Gomez-Garcia, Maria Del Consuelo
one_liner_zh: 该文结合体外实验与分子模拟，研究溶组织内阿米巴热休克转录因子EhHSTF5寡聚化增强其对EhPgp5基因启动子HSE的DNA结合，属于TF-DNA互作体系但方法以常规对接/模拟为主，AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Throughout its lifecycle, Entamoeba histolytica encounters a variety of stressful conditions. This parasite possesses Heat Shock Response Elements (HSEs) which are crucial for regulating the expression of various genes, aiding in its adaptation and survival. These HSEs are regulated by Heat Shock Transcription Factors (EhHSTFs). Our research has identified seven such factors in the parasite, designated as EhHSTF1 through to EhHSTF7. Significantly, under heat shock conditions and in the presence of the antiamoebic compound emetine, EhHSTF5, EhHSTF6, and EhHSTF7 show overexpression, highlighting their essential role in gene response to these stressors. Currently, only EhHSTF7 has been confirmed to recognize the HSE as a promoter of the EhPgp5 gene (HSE_EhPgp5), leaving the binding potential of the other EhHSTFs to HSEs yet to be explored. Consequently, our study aimed to examine, both in vitro and in silico, the oligomerization, and binding capabilities of the recombinant EhHSTF5 protein (rEhHSTF5) to HSE_EhPgp5. The in vitro results indicate that the oligomerization of rEhHSTF5 is concentration-dependent, with its dimeric conformation showing a higher affinity for HSE_EhPgp5 than its monomeric state. In silico analysis suggests that the alpha 3 alpha-helix (alpha3-helix) of the DNA-binding domain (DBD5) of EhHSTF5 is crucial in binding to the major groove of HSE, primarily through hydrogen bonding and salt-bridge interactions. In summary, our results highlight the importance of oligomerization in enhancing the affinity of rEhHSTF5 for HSE_EhPgp5 and demonstrate its ability to specifically recognize structural motifs within HSE_EhPgp5. These insights significantly contribute to our understanding of one of the potential molecular mechanisms employed by this parasite to efficiently respond to various stressors, thereby enabling successful adaptation and survival within its host environment.
abstract_zh: 在其整个生命周期中，溶组织内阿米巴（Entamoeba histolytica）会遭遇多种应激条件。该寄生虫拥有热休克反应元件（HSEs），这些元件对调控多种基因的表达至关重要，有助于其适应和生存。这些HSEs受热休克转录因子（EhHSTFs）调控。我们的研究在该寄生虫中鉴定出七个此类因子，分别命名为EhHSTF1至EhHSTF7。值得注意的是，在热休克条件下以及存在抗阿米巴化合物依米丁（emetine）时，EhHSTF5、EhHSTF6和EhHSTF7表现出过表达，突显了它们在基因对这些应激源反应中的关键作用。目前，仅确认EhHSTF7能识别HSE作为EhPgp5基因的启动子（HSE_EhPgp5），而其他EhHSTFs与HSEs的结合潜力尚待探索。因此，我们的研究旨在通过体外和计算机模拟（in silico）方法，检测重组EhHSTF5蛋白（rEhHSTF5）的寡聚化及其与HSE_EhPgp5的结合能力。体外结果表明，rEhHSTF5的寡聚化呈浓度依赖性，其二聚体构象对HSE_EhPgp5的亲和力高于单体状态。计算机模拟分析提示，EhHSTF5的DNA结合域（DBD5）中的alpha 3 alpha-螺旋（alpha3-螺旋）在结合HSE大沟中起关键作用，主要通过氢键和盐桥相互作用实现。总之，我们的结果强调了寡聚化在增强rEhHSTF5对HSE_EhPgp5亲和力中的重要性，并展示了其特异性识别HSE_EhPgp5内结构基序的能力。这些见解显著增进了我们对寄生虫为有效应对各种应激源而采用的潜在分子机制之一的理解，从而使其能在宿主环境中成功适应和生存。
